description: create_campaign under its old name: one brief → post, story, square, web banner, YouTube thumbnail and A4 poster in one look on one page, each composed for its size, never stretched. Counts as one design. Returns the link (for the signed-in person only) and every artboard.

photo.description: words to find one photo used across the campaign; none: the templates’ own
